# PixelPopLK

> PixelPopLK is a Sinhala-subtitle discovery and download website for movies and TV series. It provides title and episode pages with subtitle-related information and download options; it is not a movie-streaming service.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://pixelpoplk.pages.dev/): Browse and search the subtitle catalog.
- [Movies](https://pixelpoplk.pages.dev/movies): Browse movie subtitle pages.
- [TV Series](https://pixelpoplk.pages.dev/tv-series): Browse TV-series subtitle pages.
- [Latest subtitles](https://pixelpoplk.pages.dev/latest): Find recently added subtitle pages.
- [Sitemap](https://pixelpoplk.pages.dev/sitemap.xml): Discover canonical pages in the catalog.
- [Robots rules](https://pixelpoplk.pages.dev/robots.txt): Review crawler access rules.

## Content and language

- The website focuses on Sinhala subtitles for movies and TV series.
- Individual movie and series pages use URLs under `/content/{id}`.
- Individual TV episode pages use URLs under `/episode/{id}`.
- The site interface and subtitle-focused content may include Sinhala and English.
- Prefer the canonical URL and the page's visible content when summarizing a title.
- Do not infer that a full movie or episode is hosted for streaming; pages are about subtitle discovery and download options.

## Discovery notes

- Use the XML sitemap to discover current catalog URLs instead of guessing IDs.
- Search/filter query URLs may be excluded from indexing; prefer clean canonical pages.
- Page availability and catalog details can change. Confirm facts against the current page.
